title: The 4 Best Garden Hoses for Small Yards
h1: The 4 Best Garden Hoses for Small Yards
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for garden hoses for small yards, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at garden hoses for small yards using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Water Right 400 Series Slim and Light Polyurethane Hose 50 ft.
products.blurb: Key specs: 7/16-inch slim polyurethane construction, About 3 pounds per 50 feet, Drinking water safe, lead and BPA free.
strengths: Lightest usable hose in this list, easy for anyone to coil and move one-handed
Strain reliefs at both ends resist the kinking that happens right at the spigot
Slim diameter tucks into narrow garden beds and around container plants easily
limitations: Narrower 7/16-inch bore delivers less flow than a standard 5/8-inch hose
Costs more per foot than a comparable rubber hose
Less abrasion resistance on rough concrete or gravel than a thicker hose
features: Drinking water safe, lead and BPA free
Reinforced strain reliefs at both ends

products.name: Flexzilla Garden Hose 5/8 in. x 50 ft.
products.blurb: Key specs: 5/8-inch hybrid polymer construction, Zero memory, lies flat after use, Anodized aluminum fittings.
strengths: Full 5/8-inch flow with noticeably less weight than a comparable rubber hose
Stays flexible in cold weather instead of stiffening up
limitations: Bright green or blue color is not to everyone's taste
Heavier than the slimmer polyurethane options on this list
Fittings can loosen over time and need occasional hand-tightening
features: Zero memory, lies flat after use

products.name: Teknor Apex NeverKink 8615-50 Garden Hose 5/8 in. x 50 ft.
products.blurb: Key specs: Dual-layer reinforced construction, Corkscrew-resistant sheathing, 5/8-inch diameter, 50-foot length.
strengths: Reinforced sheathing resists the tight coiling and corner-wrapping typical of small yards
Lifetime warranty is a genuine long-term value for a mid-priced hose
Stays round rather than flattening when stepped on
limitations: Heavier than Water Right or Flexzilla at the same length
Stiffer out of the box until it breaks in over a few uses

products.name: Gilmour Platinum Flexogen 8-Ply Garden Hose 5/8 in. x 50 ft.
products.blurb: Key specs: 8-ply Flexogen construction, 500 PSI burst strength, 5/8-inch diameter, 50-foot length.
strengths: 8-ply construction is unusually durable for the price point
500 PSI burst rating is well above typical residential water pressure
Solid brass couplings hold up better than plastic threads over years of use
limitations: Heavier and stiffer than the polyurethane and hybrid polymer options here
Coils less neatly, tends to hold a slight memory curve
Fewer color options than newer hose lines

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
